formula: For each fixed order: 2*log P(full patient + native context) - log P(patient masked + same native context) - log P(frozen content-free prior); then existing majority/mean tie-break.
primary: Patient contrast versus existing calibrated majority: both-endpoint accuracy and target accuracy per model. Require joint benefit before expansion; compare old v1 and uncalibrated vote separately.
scope: Same40 exposed R3 source pairs, endpoints answered independently. Not independent generalization; not medical causal inference.
permissions: Only two exact current-question occurrences replaced by [MASK] in background prompts. Native retrieval/system/role content otherwise identical; no labels, other endpoint, or training answers in model requests.
costs: Deployment12 scores per case, versus6 for calibrated control; same original model and public resources. Deterministic extra score calls add computation, not new evidence.
